title: Cleanlist AI: Natural-language prospecting: find, enrich and sync leads. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Cleanlist AI turns any prospecting input into a verified, enriched, CRM-ready lead list. Upload a CSV, paste LinkedIn or Sales Navigator URLs, add domains, or use search filters, then let AI agents enrich contacts, verify emails, research each lead, and sync the final list to your CRM. With a 15-provider enrichment waterfall, AI research columns, and one-click CRM sync, Cleanlist helps GTM teams build lists without stitching together six tools.
